models.name: Plant growth and C4 cooling
models.status: Mechanistic research model; species calibration absent
supported: Carbon, water and nitrogen conservation checks are implemented.
Shared forcing enables paired plant-type and cooling comparisons.
A Python translation and parity tests are included in the source package.
limits: Plant shapes and organ allometry are schematic, not calibrated reconstructions.
Proposed C4 circulation remains an unvalidated intervention hypothesis.
Series saved in this workspace represent the first weather realization; ensemble results remain in raw records.

models.name: Evolution and optimization
models.status: Analytical limits checked; reproductive fitness uncalibrated
supported: Implemented checks cover neutral fixation/rate checks, seeded event-time checks, analytical Sobol/Morris examples and PCA eigensystem checks.
Search and biological evolution use distinct interpretations.
limits: Three allocation fractions share an enzyme budget, alongside stomatal conductance. This differs from an unconstrained, independently varying biochemical trait model.
Seasonal selection uses integrated leaf physiology with prescribed soil wetness, not a rainfall-driven soil bucket or seed-yield fitness.
No C2 mechanism, genotype-resolved inheritance or empirical reproductive-fitness calibration.

models.name: T-cell proliferation
models.status: Analytical and renewal benchmarks; no assay calibration
supported: Implemented checks cover analytical limits, stochastic accounting and framework-specific checks.
Activation, birth–death, Bellman–Harris, multitype Galton–Watson and Cyton variants remain distinct choices.
limits: Daughter independence and initial age-zero assumptions remain model restrictions.
No cytometry observation model, measured-data likelihood or fitted parameter uncertainty.

models.name: Fatty-acid synthesis
models.status: Independent ODE solver comparison; rounded thesis parameters
supported: Implemented checks cover independent SciPy Radau checks: approximately 0.1514% and 0.0407% maximum species-peak-normalized error for the tested inhibition-on/off cases.
Synthesis invariant and nonnegativity checks are included.
limits: Agreement between solvers is not empirical validation.
No experimental data have been refitted in this release.

models.name: Lipid metabolism
models.status: Implemented positive-rate equations do not establish bistability
supported: Release 32 independent Radau comparison: approximately 0.00763% maximum peak-normalized trajectory error in the tested case.
The implemented equilibrium reduction is monotone under its enforced positive-rate assumptions, allowing at most one physical equilibrium.
limits: This statement concerns these exact equations, not every model in the PhD work.
No claim of three equilibria, hysteresis or a validated bistable switch is supported here.

models.name: Leaf physiology
models.status: Numerical translation checked; species calibration absent
supported: Implemented checks cover 27 light/temperature/allocation cases and the Python/JavaScript comparison.
Carbon closure, energy constraints, boundary resistance and dry-state infeasibility are checked.
limits: The resource-constrained extension differs from the original archive equations.
Existing fixed-input source checks do not reproduce the full notebook optimization/evolution pipeline.

models.name: Random processes
supported: Seeded configurations and completed trajectories can be saved and rerun.
Truncation and safety-cap status remain in the original model record.
limits: No biological calibration is implied by toy growth geometry.
Event-index playback and physical-time sampling must not be interpreted interchangeably.
